notes.title: Small update with minor fixes + Franchise sale!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! As we told you last week, [b]our latest game “Monster Prom 4: Monster Con” is out now[/b]. So far the reception has been really good, which makes us incredibly happy!

To celebrate it, we’re making a [b]very light update of our previous games with a couple minor fixes[/b]. Nothing especially noticeable, mind you: we just wanted to celebrate the release of the latest installment of this weird little franchise.

As part of that celebration, [b]we’ve also set up a Franchise Sale:[/b] all of the games of the Monster Prom saga have record discounts. If you’re missing one of the games of the franchise or want to learn all about the Monster Prom Universe in its entirety, now is the best time to do it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317550/520b2c62865fb886c5bcbbe313c658dd6d3f237e.png[/img]

Here's the[b] link to the sale[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/monsterpromfranchisesale]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/monsterpromfranchisesale[/url]

Keep in mind that [b]the franchise sale also includes “Monster Prom 4: Monster Con”[/b]. The game has an official price of $15, but there's a[b] special 10% discount if you get it now[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317550/e11df5e204eb09936c4e235724ad940b246809ab.png[/img]

And if you’re a diehard of the franchise, we also have [b]two new DLCs available[/b], which together include four fan-favorites as [b]alternative Playable Characters[/b]: Damien & Valerie, Aaravi & and Milo.

You can get each pair separately, but you can also [b]get all four with the All-Access Bundle DLC [/b]below: 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50938/Monster_Con_All_Access_Bundle/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50938/Monster_Con_All_Access_Bundle/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317550/653c684e5033adeb6156a8f35205d241a14630b8.png[/img]

As always, remember you can come discuss the game with other fans & us: http://discord.gg/monsterprom. 

Hope you enjoy the Monster Con, and the rest of the Monster Prom saga! 😉

notes.title: NEW ACCESSIBILITY OPTIONS AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Welcome everyone!

Today we bring a surprise: new content!

Well, first and foremost, we're doing [b]huge deals[/b] for all the "Monster Prom" games and DLCs. Were you longing that last piece to have the whole franchise? Today's the day! We're doing discounts bigger than we've ever done before. 

You can check all the deals here: [url=]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/monsterpromfranchise [/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yNC0JKB.png[/img]

But that's not all!
We're releasing new features for "Monster Camp" and "Monster Roadtrip".

[b]ACCESSIBILITY OPTIONS[/b]
Now both "Monster Camp" and "Monter Roadtrip" have an option to switch to special fonts:
[list]
[*] Accessible font (which should work with text-to-speech software)
[*] Dyslexia friendly font
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CLTLLf4.png[/img]

[b]FAN TRANSLATION MODTOOL[/b] 
This is a modtool that allows people to (individually or collectivelly) do fan translations. 
You get a document with the game's texts and you can write a translation. 

Remember we created a channel in our Discord server just for that. The idea is there you can find other people interested and team up. 

This modtool is available only for "Monster Camp". Depending on its performance we might explore releasing it for "Monster Roadtrip" as well.

Keep in mind right now it's in a beta stage, so it probably has errors. Feel free to share your thoughts on the Discord server. These days we will be looking at the modtool's performance to find errors and fix them. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tYtzbaS.png[/img]

We hope these new features help new people to enjoy these games we've made. 
And, of course, don't forget to wishlist our upcoming game,[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/][b] "Monster Prom 4: Monster Con"[/b][/url]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/

Best regards,
the Beautiful Glitch team

notes.title: AUGUST UPDATE: "End of the Road"
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Today we released the[b] August Update[/b], also known as "[b]End of the Road[/b]". 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4C8zSpM.jpg[/img]

This update is HUGE. It's so big we must say no one should use this as references for future updates ever.

"End of the Road" must be unlocked. The way of unlocking it is rather simple, so probably many of you will have it unlocked it by default. 
Triggering it? That's another story. Triggering this content might take some tries and definitely some time. 
But we think it'll be worth it! 

It's important to note the content is tied to a[b] Trigger Warning[/b]. Once unlocked, "End of the Road" must be activated on the menu, and there you can read the Trigger Warning. 
The tone of it can get heavy at times, definitely heavier than "Monster Roadtrip" usual tone. But we'd say this is not the heaviest content the Monster Prom franchise has ever seen. "Monster Prom" already has plotlines that are probably heavier than this one. But back when "Monster Prom" we didn't have a Trigger Warning system! 


[img]https://i.imgur.com/RJCj1se.jpg[/img]

We've poured lots of work and love into creating this content. We truly hope you enjoy it. We'd LOVE to see your thoughts and reactions. Best way is by joining the conversation in the Monster Prom official Discord server: [b][url=http://www.discord.gg/monsterprom]http://www.discord.gg/monsterprom[/url][/b]

The server is also a great place to discuss all things Monster Prom with other fans, and it might be a good place to ask for any question you may have, such as how to unlock/trigger this new content if you can't find it! 
Come join us! 

But that's not all...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/P7kpbB5.jpg[/img]

Today we release "Monster Roadtrip" on the [b]Nintendo Switch[/b].
"[b]Monster Roadtrip XXL[/b]" comes with the 4 alternative playable characters, and it costs [b]$19.99[/b]
Additionally, you can purchase a DLC bundling all the [b]Color Squad as hitchhikers[/b]. It costs [b]$4.99[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vBUQw1n.jpg[/img]

And that's all for today. 
As always: thanks for your support (:

notes.title: MAY UPDATE: Welcome to the Meta-Cabin
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ub7P4Wv.png[/img]

MAY UPDATE IS HERE!

We just released the May Update. This includes one thing: the last location of the game, the Meta-Cabin. 

Only one thing?
Well yes. As mentioned, we're nearing towards the end of the "content-packed" updates. 
Still, don't fret: it might be just one location;  but it's FULL OF SECRETS. 

Believe us, you'll wanna visit this location multiple times, in order to unearth all the cool things it has in store for you. 

Oh, yeah! This location must be unlocked first. You must first visit all other location in order to even visit this one. Mark our words: it's quite worth it. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ez9wETQ.png[/img]

notes.title: APRIL UPDATE: Finn and the first Sticker Pack
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/e5XF6pz.png[/img]

APRIL UPDATE IS HERE!

We just released the April Update, which includes a number of things:

New Hitchhiker: Finn
New Feature: Sticker Packs

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rkhFTcE.png[/img]

New Hitchhiker: Finn

Who's Finn? Why he rings a bell? 
He's the poor dude whose main job is carrying Mr. Pappas chair. 
But it was about time Finn caught a break... and maybe you can help him in doing that. 

Find Finn at the Bust Stop and get to know him better. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0f3WPdB.png[/img]

New Feature: Sticker Packs

Soon the time of big content updates will come to an end. That's a fact.
Big content updates mean the ones with Locations and Hitchhikers. 

But we want to keep throwing updates at you (even if maybe NOT one per month... that's just a lot).
What we can offer you once all the content has been served? Sticker Packs

Sticker Packs bring around 10 new stickers each. 
You can check them in the Gallery or use them in the Sticker Studio.

We also want to hold a couple contests where the prize will be proposing your own idea for a sticker! (:
We actually did for the April Update and 3 winners proposed ideas that became 3 new stickers. Hooray!  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RNIDeWo.png[/img]

And that's all!
As per usual, we hope you like the new content we've brewed for you.
See you on next Update! 

(:

notes.title: MARCH UPDATE: Brian, Vicky... and an Adorable Village!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1665190/Monster_Prom_3_Monster_Roadtrip/][img]https://i.imgur.com/DRU9Qsw.png[/img][/url]

[b]MARCH UPDATE IS HERE! 
[/b]
We just released the March Update, which includes a number of things:

[list]
[*]New Location: The Adorable Village
[*]New Feature: The Phone Call
[*]New DLC: Vicky and Brian as Hitchhikers![/list]

Let's check all of this!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PyQ0151.png[/img]

[u][b]New Location: The Adorable Village
[/b][/u]

Welcome to the Adorable Village.
This Location includes three events and not one but FOUR new NPCs! 
It also has some nice new art assets... like the Froggy Iron Maiden. Kawaii! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QimILXc.png[/img]

[u][b]New Feature: The Phone Call[/b][/u]

We added a new QoL feature... it's the Phone Call! 
On the Rest Stop’s Info Board (the place with the Map) you can now call any of the hitchhikers to ensure they appear at the Bus Stop if you go there on the next Rest Stop!

It takes one more Week; but you can 100% find any hitchhiker you want!

This is a way for players to removing RNG at the cost of an extra turn. Surely a delight for completionists and people who just want to romance Damien for the 50th time in a row. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337900/Monster_Roadtrip_Hitchhiker_Pack__Vicky__Brian/][img]https://i.imgur.com/vF7ySsf.png[/img][/url]

[u][b]New DLC: Vicky and Brian as Hitchhikers![/b][/u]

We released a new DLC that allows you to pick up Vicky and Brian as hitchhikers. A great way to get to know them better... and even to romance them!
You've seen these two undead hotties again and again... but it's time to see them under a new light!

As with all hitchhikers, each Vicky and Brian come with...
[list]
[*]1 Passive Effect 
[*]4 Conversations
[*]1 Deep Conversation
[*]1 Road Event (with exciting new non-model NPCs!)
[*]1 Date Ending
[*]And many zany bubbles!
[/list]

And that's not all! Brian's passive effect includes... A NEW SONG! 
Yeah, get ready to rejoice with... The Brian Song


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337900/Monster_Roadtrip_Hitchhiker_Pack__Vicky__Brian/][img]https://i.imgur.com/oROfs4D.png[/img][/url]



And that's all! 
Super excited to see if you like this new Location and the DLC. We're always intrigued to see how people react to finally seeing the original PCs as fleshed out characters!
Next monthly update will probably happen by the end of April, so... see you in a month and a half! 

(:

notes.title: FEBRUARY UPDATE: Welcome to the Sticker Studio! (also BIG FRANCHISE SALE)
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/beautifulglitch/sale/monsterprom][img]https://i.imgur.com/RoJ2D7K.png[/img][/url]

[b]FIRST OF ALL: THERE'S A BIG-ASS MONSTER PROM FRANCHISE SALE! 
[/b]
We're offering BIG discounts for all our games! 
We're lowering some of our games to their lowest price point yet! 
It even marks the first time ever we discount the "Monster Roadtrip" DLCs!

You can find all the discounts here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/beautifulglitch/sale/monsterprom]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/beautifulglitch/sale/monsterprom[/url]

Ah, what a juicy opportunity to go all in with your shameless and joyful thirst for hot monsters!

And that's not all, since...
[b]A new month brings a new update!
[/b]
We just released the February Update, which includes a number of things:

[list]
[*]New Hitchhiker: Hope
[*]New Feature: Sticker Studio
[*]New Feature: In-game Achievements[/list]

Let's check all of this!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T96ty95.png[/img]

[u][b]New Hitchhiker: Hope
[/b][/u]

It's the sassiest of the Coven witches, nonetheless!
Let Hope join your road trip and learn much more about her! From her passion for competitive tarot to her role within the Coven!

As with all hitchhikers, this includes
[list]
[*]1 Passive Effect (the Witching Week)
[*]4 Conversations
[*]1 Deep Conversation
[*]1 Road Event (with 3 new non-model NPCs!)
[*]1 Date Ending
[*]And many zany bubbles!
[/list]

Are you ready to fulfill Damien's dream and go on a trip with Hope? Let's go!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rLI52cR.png[/img]

[u][b]New Feature: Sticker Studio[/b][/u]

Another cool fact about Monster Roadtrip's February Update? We're releasing a new feature: Sticker Studio.
There you can create cool scenes by meshing together the different stickers from the game on one of many backgrounds.

Keep in mind this is a sort of "beta version". Expect some bugs and errors. We will work on polishing it and improving it a bit more!
This is an entire new feature we were very excited to include in this game. After creating so many charming stickers, we had to give them another (cool) use!

Feel free of reporting bugs or errors on our official Discord server. 
And ofc, we'll love for you to share your creations! Please share them! Bring them to social media or to our Discord server! We want to see! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LGasyP6.png[/img]


[u][b]New Feature: In-game Achievements[/b][/u]

Last but not least, we added a small QoL feature: now you can follow your achievement progress in-game. Look for it on the main menu!
This should make easier and fancier to keep track of your achievements. We also hope this way more people will get curious about the many achievements to achieve! 

How many of 'em have you gotten already? 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/beautifulglitch/sale/monsterprom][img]https://i.imgur.com/UQasYaC.png[/img][/url]


And that's all! 
We hope you like these little things we keep adding to the game. 
We still have some fuel to keep going with monthly updates (it will be a thing until probably the middle of 2023). So... see y'all in a month for the March update!

(:

notes.title: JANUARY UPDATE: The Kite Tournament is Here!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to 2023!
[/b]
January may come to an end; but the Kite Tournament is only beginning!
We released the January Update, which includes a number of things:

[list]
[*]New Location: Kite Tournament
[*]New Gallery Category: Icons
[*]Monster Roadtrip: Original Soundtrack
[*]PANCAKE SONG 10H VERSION!!!!!1
[/list]

Let's check all of this!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fee5fdr.png[/img]

[u][b]New Location: Kite Tournament
[/b][/u]
This new location includes...
[list]
[*]3 events (as per usual)
[*]A new incremental event (the really big ones)
[*]3 NPCs with full models (2 returning ones and 1 brand new one
[*]A shiny wide background
[*]Around 10 new icons for NPCs, with and without models!
[*]A TOURNAMENT ARC!
[/list]

Go there and live your most epic anime fantasies by enacting your own tournament arc. 
Are you ready to fly your kites high?!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lyU4bS9.png[/img]

[u][b]New Gallery Category: Icons[/b][/u]

We added a category in the gallery for the icons. This includes all NPCs with icons, even the ones without a model! 
That's A LOT OF CHARACTERS!
This franchise has always shined for having an endless stream the wacky characters, and it makes us happy how this game finally give many of them a silly icons. 
You'll find icons of 200+ characters! 
Gotta meet 'em all!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291500/Monster_Prom_3_Monster_Roadtrip_Soundtrack/][img]https://i.imgur.com/QVxtXPn.png[/img][/url]

[u][b]Monster Roadtrip: Original Soundtrack[/b][/u]

Why choose one of the 4 mixtapes in "Monster Roadtrip" when you can get 'em all with this bombastic OST?!
Here's a link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291500/Monster_Prom_3_Monster_Roadtrip_Soundtrack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291500/Monster_Prom_3_Monster_Roadtrip_Soundtrack/
[/url]
Wanna get chill? Go "Lo Fi Beats".
Feel like partying? Then hit the "Tropical Rave".
What if you want to go all in on the "road trip in the desert" fantasy? We have "Desert Vibes" for you.
Or maybe you prefer Monster Prom's classic style? Then "Surf Rock" will be your jam!

As if having the contents of 4 mixtapes wasn't enough, there's also a secret final mixtape we like to call "Other Cool Songs": from the banger that is "Five Stars, Ten out of Ten" to the overly-suggestive "Whale Sex Jazz".

Oh, and there's also 2 full minutes of the Pancake Song, which alone should be enough to convince you to get this soundtrack. Because, you know... even if you don't like pancakes, you will have to sing along.

[url=https://youtu.be/bH1ER6tHL8o][img]https://i.imgur.com/JVJHa8C.png[/img][/url]

[/b][/u]
Yes. We released a 10h version of everyone's favorite pancake-themed videogame song, the "Pancake Song". 
Here, go watch it: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bH1ER6tHL8o]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bH1ER6tHL8o[/url]

Apparently we can embed videos here? Lemme try...
[previewyoutube=bH1ER6tHL8o;full][/previewyoutube]

It includes the lyrics, in case you want to sing along (jk, even if you don't like pancakes you will have to sing along). 
Only true pancake fans know the lyrics to the 10 hour version of the "Pancake Song". 
The real question is: can this video become so popular that we get big music artists doing their own covers? Which artist you'd want to see doing their own "Pancake Song" remix/cover? Lil Nas X? Rosalía? Mozart? 

GO LISTEN TO THE PANCAKE SONG! DEVOUR THE PANCAKE SONG! BECOME THE PANCAKE SONG! 🥞🥞🥞

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291500/Monster_Prom_3_Monster_Roadtrip_Soundtrack/][img]https://i.imgur.com/osIuZyu.png[/img][/url]

We hope you like these little things we keep adding to the game. 
We still have some fuel to keep going with monthly update (it will be a thing until probably the middle of 2023). So... see y'all in some weeks for the February update!

notes.title: Winter Update + New DLC
notes.content:
Happy holidays! 

We're releasing now a new DLC and a very special update for everyone. 

[b]The new DLC brings Amira and Oz... as hitchhikers! [/b]
Yes, you can now meet and even romance these two. Get ready for conversations and events that will provide more lore and character. It's time to get to know them better. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251130/Monster_Roadtrip_Hitchhiker_Pack__Amira__Oz/][img]https://i.imgur.com/11ksAFA.pnghttps://i.imgur.com/11ksAFA.png
[/img][/url]

There's also a free update. The main course is a whole new hitchhiker you can meet in the BUS STOP. It's none other than [b]Adrien, the valiant merknight[/b]. Adrien's conversations will give you much more information about the Merkingdom. Huzzah!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tNA0opr.png[/img]

We're also introducing the [b]Great Glorious Gacha[/b]. From now on, playing Monster Roadtrip (and especially witnessing new content in your runes) will make you earn [b]PRANK TOKENS[/b]. This currency can then be used in the meta-shop, as coins for the Great Glorious Gacha. This magic machine will randomly give you a prize, which are for the most part beautiful content for the gallery. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CLWXR15.png[/img]

And with the Great Glorious Gacha, we also bring the last missing piece of the Gallery: [b]SKETCHES[/b]!
Sketches can be unlocked through the Great Glorious Gacha. They are super cool and provide a sneak peek behind the scenes. You can get to see discarded designs for existing characters and even some content that was never implemented in the game! 
Go unlock all that juicy art!

[b]NOTE: [/b]you will get a bunch of PRANK TOKENS retroactively if you've been playing Monster Roadtrip! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QLuuTp0.png[/img]

There's the[b] achievements[/b] too. We're implementing them! 
The art/icons of the achievements aren't fully done just yet. Please note: for the time being a number of achievements will use a placeholder as the main art, but we will update that quite soon. We just didn't want to delay this feature because of the missing icons. 

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE: [/b]purely narrative-based achievements are not retroactive as of now, and unfortunately you will need to achieve them again. 


Finally, there's the [b]Steam stuff[/b]!
You know: trading cards, emojis, badges...
They are not released as of now, but they should be out in the following days. Go collect them! 


[b]FINAL NOTE: [/b]the nature of this update will delete the last save state. This does NOT mean you will lose progress. It just means that if you had a run saved you won't be able of resuming it (and you will need to start a new run). 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KCmLQBj.png[/img]

And that's it! 

Are you excited? We've worked hard on this update and we hope it brings you joy! (: 

Best regards,

the Beautiful Glitch team

notes.title: NOVEMBER UPDATE: Gallery; manual; and a new location!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! 

We come today with a new update.
This includes:

[list]
[*]A first iteration of the GALLERY. Some content is still missing. You should be able of auto-unlocking all content you already saw.
[*]The MANUAL. It's a friggin' long comprehensive guide explaining almost all the systems in the game. it's wordy AF. It's not a must-read if you have gotten the gist of the game; but more of a place where you can go and consult anything you are not sure about.
[*]A brand new location: the "End of the World" Summit. A wicked place where villains gather. Be ready to meet 6 returning NPCs who weren't present in Monster Roadtrip till now (and then some other NPCs that were). Excited? 

[/list]

And that'd be all! 
Here's a fun fact: today power on our building went out and releasing this was an ordeal. It might be there's errors. We will fix them during the following days. Hope you understand! 

We hope you enjoy it (:
